name: Dolanaar
summary: At Dolanaar, travelers and guides gather beneath Teldrassil’s boughs. Southwest of Shadowglen, the town is the first place young night elves reach after leaving their sheltered training grounds. Rangers, druids, and craftsmen help newcomers as strange afflictions spread through the World Tree.

sections.title: A Crossroads of Boughs
sections.body: Beneath Teldrassil’s canopy, Dolanaar is a crossroads for travelers. Southwest of Shadowglen, its homes and platforms follow the traditional night elven way, woven into the woodland. Young night elves come here for their first broad training in trades, martial arts, and nature crafts. The road west leads toward Darnassus, the capital. Reports of corrupted wildlife, aggressive furbolgs, and foul mosses come from the surrounding boughs, and Dolanaar’s council hears them.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Dolanaar?
faq.answer: Dolanaar is the main hub and outpost for young night elves leaving Shadowglens novice grounds. Tradesfolk and trainers in martial and magical arts gather here, and the town links travelers to the capital.
Dolanaar lies in central-eastern Teldrassil, a short walk down the trail southwest of Shadowglen and east of Darnassus.

faq.q: How can travelers reach Darnassus from here?
faq.answer: Follow the forest road west through Teldrassil on foot to reach the gates of Darnassus. Dolanaar has no flight path of its own.
Strange corruption spreads through the woodland around Dolanaar. Diseased beasts, crazed timberlings, and hostile furbolg tribes threaten the area.

angles.text: As a young night elf, you take your first steps into the wider world at Dolanaar. The growing corruption of the World Tree tests your vow to preserve nature.
As a druid initiate, you can seek guidance at Dolanaar on Teldrassil’s ailments and learn to attune your spirit to nature’s balance.
